title: Political Ideology Shifts in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.16013v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in politically sensitive contexts, raising concerns about their susceptibility to ideological biases. In this work, we examine how synthetic persona conditioning shapes ideological expression across seven open-weight instruction-tuned models (7B-72B parameters) using the Political Compass Test (62 statements) as a standardized behavioral probe. Across three studies involving 200,000 synthetic personas and more than 260 million model responses, we analyze implicit and explicit malleability, as well as theme-associated variations. We find that: (i) larger models exhibit broader implicit ideological coverage, increasing from 14-35% for 7-8B models to up to 49% for 70B+ models; (ii) explicit ideological priming induces large and statistically significant shifts, with right-authoritarian cues moving all models in the intended direction and producing larger effects in most model-axis c

translated_title: 大语言模型中的政治意识形态转变
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在政治敏感的场景中，这引发了人们对其易受意识形态偏见影响的担忧。在本研究中，我们使用政治罗盘测试（62个陈述）作为标准化的行为探针，考察了合成人格条件化如何塑造七个开源权重指令微调模型（7B-72B参数）的意识形态表达。在涉及20万个合成人格和超过2.6亿次模型响应的三项研究中，我们分析了隐性和显性的可塑性，以及与主题相关的变化。我们发现：(i) 更大的模型表现出更广的隐性意识形态覆盖范围，从7-8B模型的14-35%增加到70B+模型的最高49%；(ii) 显性的意识形态引导会引起巨大且统计显著的转变，右翼威权主义线索使所有模型朝预期方向移动，并在大多数模型-轴组合中产生更大的效应……
tldr: 该研究通过20万个合成人格和超过2.6亿次模型响应的大规模实验发现，大语言模型规模越大其隐性意识形态覆盖范围越广，而显性的意识形态引导能显著且可控地改变模型的政治立场。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale experiments with 200,000 synthetic personas and over 260 million model responses, this study shows that larger LLMs exhibit broader implicit ideological coverage and that explicit ideological priming significantly and controllably shifts models' political stances.
